Sana (Customer): Hey team, since yesterday's model maintenance our product is returning weird templated responses for multi-step prompts. Examples attached in the ticket. This started right after you rolled a quant profile change. :frowning:
Diego (Support): Sorry to hear that, Sana. Ticket #C-98321 created and I've added logs. Can you paste a minimal repro? Also which model + deployment are you on?
Sana (Customer): We're on rwd-11B-v2 served in hosted-us-west1. The rollout note mentioned int8 profile id qp-2026-04. Minimal repro below.
Sana (Customer): ```
Input: "Write a 3-step plan to onboard a new engineer, include 1 sentence per step."
Expected (pre-rollout): "1. Set up dev environment. 2. Introduce codebase and team. 3. Assign first small project."
Actual (post-rollout): "[STEP 1] Onboarding initiated. [STEP 2] Continue. [STEP 3] Complete."
``` 
Morgan (CS): Noted. That actual output looks like tokenization/templating artifacts, not just semantic drift. Any chance you use a prompt wrapper on your side that might be getting truncated? :thinking:
Sana (Customer): No wrapper, raw prompt via API. We logged request/response and included traces. Latency unchanged, no errors. Only changed after the "qp-2026-04 int8" rollout on 1898454000.
TriageBot: New escalation label applied: quantization-regression. Priority: high.
Diego (Support): Can you share the full request payload (headers redacted) and the exact model/quant metadata that your call returned? Also: were you calling with streaming or non-streaming?
Sana (Customer): Non-streaming. Payload: prompt as above, max_tokens=128, temperature=0.2. Response metadata shows model_version: rwd-11B-v2@qp-2026-04-int8, kernel: fast-attn-v3.
Aisha (ML Eng): Thanks — that metadata confirms it's the int8 profile. Two hypotheses: 1) quant calibration changed logits for control tokens causing repeated bracketed markers; 2) error in postprocessing that mis-parses logits when certain token ids map differently after quantization. Do you have token-level output or N-best candidates?
Sana (Customer): We logged the top_k=5 completions for the example. Attaching snippet:
Sana (Customer): ```
Top probs (prefix): ["[", "STEP", "1", "]", "Onboarding"]
Top completions: ["[STEP 1] Onboarding initiated.", "1. Set up dev environment.", "[STEP 1] ..."]
``` 
Morgan (CS): Interesting — the expected clean sentence appears in the N-best but not as the top prediction. That suggests a score shift, not total collapse.
Elena (Eng): Can you run a quick repro on a dedicated canary with qp-2026-03 (previous profile) vs qp-2026-04 to compare logits? If we can reproduce locally we can bisect the quant change. Also include seed/temperature.
Diego (Support): I've requested a canary run from infra on the customer's sample. ETA 30m. Adding flags: deterministic_seed=42, top_k=5.
Aisha (ML Eng): If repro matches, I'll diff per-layer activation ranges and quant scale tables. If it's only affecting control tokens like punctuation/brackets, we might fix by clamping scales or remapping special token IDs before quant.
Sana (Customer): Thanks. The regression is blocking a subset of our workflows that rely on exact step formatting. Appreciate the quick help.
Diego (Support): For immediate mitigation, can you pin to qp-2026-03? We can rollback the profile for your org while we investigate. Would you like us to do that?
Sana (Customer): Yes please, pin me back. That will buy time.
TriageBot: Rollback request created: rollback-req-7742. Owner: infra-team. Status: pending.
Morgan (CS): Follow-up: please keep logs of any other prompts showing bracket/tokens artifacts. We'll bundle samples for the ML team.
Aisha (ML Eng): I'll start bisecting once canary results arrive. I'll post progress and a shortlist of candidate fixes (scale clamping, remap special token handling, quant-aware bias correction). :mag:
Elena (Eng): If we need a fast hotfix, we can release a micro-profile that avoids the problematic kernel selection for those token ranges.
Diego (Support): Noting impact: formatting-sensitive customers affected. Escalating to eng and ML. Assigned to Aisha + Elena. Keeping Sana updated.
Sana (Customer): Appreciate it. Please confirm when rollback is complete.
Diego (Support): Will do. :thumbsup:
